title: AI-Powered Price Negotiation Solution (Nego-Wiz)
summary: AI O2O reports that Nego-Wiz shortened negotiations at KT Commerce during a 2024–25 pilot. The amount of time saved is unreported.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AI O2O reports that Nego-Wiz shortened negotiations during a KT Commerce pilot from December 2024 to March 2025. The amount of time saved is unreported.
purpose: Automate corporate price negotiations and reduce staff workload.

ratings.reason: The supplier reports that KT Commerce shortened negotiations during its pilot. This is an operational time saving, with no amount supplied.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: AI-Powered Price Negotiation Solution (Nego-Wiz)

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.

headline: Nego-Wiz automates KT Commerce price negotiations
